description: This file defines SCSS mixins for applying background color and gradient variants to CSS selectors, primarily used for styling components with dynamic background styles in Bootstrap-based projects.

methods.name: bg-variant
methods.description: Mixin to set background color with !important and hover/focus styles
parameters: parent: selector or element to apply style to

methods.name: bg-gradient-variant
methods.description: Mixin to set a gradient background with linear-gradient and color mix
